title: JCID Product Review- JCID AiXun T420D vs. JCID AiXun T3A
description:
In this video we've compared the JCID AiXun T420D and the JCID AiXun T3A.
You can use this video to find out which of these 2 stations is right for you.

Let us know what you think!
